title: Aureon — an AI portfolio co-pilot for DIY investors
description: A light, spring-animated startup landing page for a portfolio co-pilot that links accounts read-only, looks inside every fund and drafts trades you approve. The hero is a full-width allocation bar that re-splits live as you drag a risk dial, followed by a holdings cluster, a pinned how-it-works story with swipeable trade drafts, a scrubbable retirement planner, ground rules, flat pricing and FAQ.
sections: Hero with risk dial and allocation band
features: Draggable risk dial that re-splits a full-width allocation bar through springs, driven by motion values
Live drafted trades and rolling dollar figures that follow the dial
Holdings bubble cluster that repacks per account
Swipeable deck of drafted trades with approve and skip
Scrubbable retirement planner with a redrawing area chart
Radio-card plan picker and animated fee comparison
